Welcome to the live broadcast of one of the classic encounters in Indonesian football, where Arema FC hosts the capital's Persija Jakarta at their nominal home ground, the Kapten I Wayan Dipta Stadium. This is a 'Big Match' in the Indonesian Liga 1, which always attracts huge attention from fans across the country.

Kick-off: November 8, 2025, 08:30 UTC (11:30 MSK) Stadium: Kapten I Wayan Dipta Stadium, Gianyar Competition: Indonesia Super League

Arema vs Persija Jakarta: Match Preview

Both teams come into this crucial match positioned in the upper part of the league table and fighting for the top spots. Persija Jakarta is in magnificent form and is one of the main contenders for the championship title this season. Arema, known by their nickname 'Singo Edan' (The Crazy Lions), has also shown consistent results, especially in home matches. However, the head-to-head history is entirely in favor of the capital club: Persija is unbeaten against Arema in the last 11 consecutive matches across all competitions, securing 6 wins and 5 draws. Last season's match at this stadium ended in a 2-2 draw.

Team Form and Analysis

Arema

The team will be highly motivated to break their dreadful streak against Persija. Playing in Bali as their home base, Arema feels quite confident and regularly picks up points. The team relies on physical football and fast counter-attacks. In attack, all hopes rest on the experience and skill of local striker Dedik Setiawan, as well as the creativity of Brazilian import Charles.

Persija Jakarta

The 'Kemayoran Tigers,' under coach Thomas Doll, display a very organized and tactically astute style of football. The team boasts one of the best defensive lines in the league, while their attack is spearheaded by the legendary Croatian striker Marko Šimić, who regularly scores in important matches. Persija will be aiming to extend their dominant run in clashes with Arema and secure a crucial three points in the title race.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

However, the 'Big Match' status and fan support could help Arema put up a fight.

Tottenham Hotspur vs Manchester United: Match Preview

Adding to their on-field issues is a major injury crisis, with James Maddison, Dejan Kulusevski, Yves Bissouma, Radu Drăgușin and others on the sidelines. The participation of one of the team's leaders, Mohammed Kudus, is also in doubt.

Manchester United

Under Rúben Amorim, the Red Devils are gradually finding their rhythm. The team is unbeaten in their last four league matches and has shown good goalscoring form. The manager's task is to break the dreadful streak against Tottenham.
